task.notes: t = 1/3 between the brackets (test: E7.75 at t = 1/2 between E7.5 and E8.0).

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

fgw.what: displacement interpolation between the brackets (fused Gromov-Wasserstein coupling, proper rotation, McCann moves) with a mixture of real cells of both, scaled to the embryo size rule

fgw_balanced.what: fgw with its drawn cells re-arranged over its own positions so that each position's k nearest positions hold the two brackets in the mixture's proportion as closely as one greedy pass allows (vec.t2_build.balanced_bracket_labels); displaced cells swapped in nearest pairs (relabel_rows)

fgw_patchy.what: fgw with its drawn cells re-arranged over its own positions so that bracket membership comes in spatially coherent patches, one bracket per k-means patch of the positions, round(1 / min(p, 1 - p)) patches (vec.t2_build.patchy_bracket_labels); displaced cells swapped in nearest pairs (relabel_rows)

fgw_shuffle.what: fgw with its drawn rows permuted at random within groups of k nearby positions, the span of the scorer's k-nearest-cell neighbourhoods, whatever their bracket or type (vec.t2_build.span_shuffle)
